comment: CHIMport test area (v0.0.36-dev): the 3 x 3 Bitter Coast block centred on cell (-7, 2), every cell passed in the island-wide CHIMport run. First CHIMport cells inside the legacy open world, built CHIM-native (--chim-native-towns on), to inspect the CHIM/legacy edge cell by cell. Centre = the middle of cell (-7, 2), already on the 512-unit terrain material grid. Bounds +-3072 = the three cells per axis (Balmora's frame) = the handoff core (the player changes maps on the cell edges); the frame's ground reaches 768 units further (terrain_margin, terrain only: three chunks, at least draw distance + 32 past the core, so there is ground up to the fog plane from every handover point, CHIM-FAR-BAND-GAP-36). Not shipped (no shipped_since): built only with --extra-town. Interiors (Gnaar Mok at -8, 3) not listed yet: their doors show as unavailable.

arrival.reason: Nearest dry ground to the block centre (the centre itself is marsh 48 units under water), from the cell's LAND heights.
